# Section 1: Loading Data

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

import csv file of rectangular data table using absolule path
```{r loading dataset with absolute path}
litters_df= read_csv(file= "C:/Users/mmr587/OneDrive - NYU Langone Health/OBGYN/P8105_R_Practice/data_wrangling_i/data/FAS_litters.csv")
```
Clean the variable names using janitor::clean_names()
```{r snake text variable naming}
names(litters_df)

litters_df = janitor::clean_names(litters_df)

names(litters_df)
```
Load the FAS_pups dataset using relative path:
```{r loading dataset with relative path}
pups_df= read_csv(file = "./data/FAS_pups.csv")
```
# Section 2: Looking at Data

View the data after importing: view, str, head, and tail
skimr::skim summarizes the dataset, means, standard deviation, min, max, missing

```{r}
skimr::skim(litters_df)

```
Address missing values:., NA, and blank cells will be treated as missing values. 
```{r}
litters_df= read_csv(
  file = "./data/FAS_litters.csv", 
  na= c(".", "NA", ""))
)
```

Explicitly give column specifications of variable type:
```{r}
litters_df= 
  read_csv(file= "./data/FAS_litters.csv",
                     na= c(".", "NA", ""),
                     col_types = cols(
                       Group= col_character(),
                       `Litter Number`= col_character(),
                       `GD0 weight`= col_double(),
                       `GD18 weight`= col_double(),
                       `GD of Birth`= col_integer(),
                       `Pups born alive`= col_integer(),
                       `Pups dead @ birth`= col_integer(),
                       `Pups survive`= col_integer()
                     )
           )
```


# Section 3: Pups Dataframe

View Data
```{r}
skimr::skim(pups_df)
```
rename variables and address missingness
```{r}
pups_df= read_csv("./data/FAS_pups.csv",
                  skip=3,
                  na= c(".", "NA", "")
                  )
```

categroizing variables:
```{r}
pups_df= 
  read_csv(file= "./data/FAS_pups.csv", 
           skip=3,
           na= c(".", "NA", ""),
                  col_types = cols(
                    Sex= col_character(),
                    `PD ears`= col_character(),
                    `PD eyes`= col_character(),
                    `PD pivot`= col_character(),
                    `PD walk`= col_character()
                  ))
```
